notes.title: Bugfix & Tutorial Updates
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, this is the list of some bugfix and small changes for today![/p][h2]Bugfix & Tutorial Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where stocker mixes some ammo types.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some colliders missing on items after canceling the placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you can't unlock the dialouge for selling brass box.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some skin name issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tutorial features for new players to navigate on tablet easier![/p][/*][*][p]Some optimization for lights and map![/p][/*][*][p]Added a new feature on case opening to know acquired skins bundles! [/p][/*][*][p]Sprays bottles are now in bundles of 5 and stations that use spray bottles, capacity is now 10![/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Some QOL Features
notes.content: [h2]QOL Features[/h2][list][*][p]You can pack up stations now! Make sure they don't carry any items on it and press "E" to pack up any station. You can store it again or trash it away![/p][/*][*][p]You can now pack up items on Safety Glasses Stand/Headphone Stand/Cleaning Stations. Take an empty pack or a one that carries same item and pack with left mouse button![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Changes & Bugfix
notes.content: [h2]Small Changes & Bugfix[/h2][list][*][p]Weapon cleaning machine now uses sprays.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game crashing when empty cargo boxes placed in storage shelf.[/p][/*][*][p]Some fixes on in game models.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Here Is Some Bugfix & Small Changes
notes.content: [h3]Hello everyone![/h3][p]Thank you to all who played our game, joined our community, and gave us feedback. We are going to update this game and add more content until it is ready for the full release, and this is only possible thanks to you. Here is a list of some fixed bugs and changes to make you enjoy this game more! [/p][p][/p][h2]Bugfix & Small Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Storage shelves now have labels so you can keep track of your items![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Some items had large placement borders so we trimmed them down for better placements![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that causing customers to stuck when player takes a skin from display case.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some guns are uninteractable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some items can't be stored on storage shelves.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Corrupted Saves Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Corrupted Saves Hotfix[/h2][p]Some players got the issue where their save files got corrupted, thanks to your feedback we were able to fix it so you can continue your save! Please report us any issues you have via Discord so we can fix it right away! Discord Link -> [url="https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z"]https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z[/url][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes & Changes
notes.content: [h2]Bug Fixes & Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed some issues that leads to corrupted save files[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some museum money duplication issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed while carrying an item, can access to toolbar issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some collider issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Now stocker does not carry skinned weapons![/p][/*][*][p]You can move light switch now, allowing better placements.[/p][/*][*][p]You can manage targets on level 3 range while holding a target now.[/p][/*][*][p]Knife probabilities arranged on knife box, allowing easier completion for bundles.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes & QOL Features
notes.content: [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed some customers can be id checked twice bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some cargo boxes selected bug.[/p][/*][/list][h2]QOL Features[/h2][list][*][p]You can now place Brass Boxes and Trash Bins to the range area.[/p][/*][*][p]Trash containers lids opened a bit more to throw trashes more easily.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes & Added New Resolutions
notes.content: [h2]Fixed Bugs[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed next day is not starting bug.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse sensitivity is changing while in shooting race bug. (This may reset your mouse sensitivity settings.),[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cardboard target holes border issues.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sometimes while moving object, stucks bug.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Resolutions[/h2][list][*][p]2560×1440[/p][/*][*][p]3840×2160[/p][/*][/list][p]We have changed couple of things in the settings menu, please check your setting in your next session![/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes & Museum Changes
notes.content: [p]We are constantly working on fixing bugs & add useful features. The game is in early access and launched few days ago, we are going to fix bugs and update features as we go. Thank you for your patience and please let us know if you need help![/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Added Target Fps property to the settings. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred when loading a saved game. (You can use your old save. It will work now.)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed paying money while firing an employee bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Renovation app slots overflowing bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapons can’t be moving to Non-rentable guns section bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some sounds issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pressing Pull Targets button not working sometimes bug.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed after all workers fired after next day, UI is not updating bug.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Museum & Bundles Changes[/h2][list][*][p]There are knife bundles now! (currently 5)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 new gun bundles.[/p][/*][*][p]Added UI on museum app to see which gun can be obtained from which cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized customer count who visits museum.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Day 1 Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing our game from the launch day! We fixed bugs and improved the game thanks to your feedback. Here is a list for general changes on this update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed money from balloons falling down from plane.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game lagging while music is changing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong daily report stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Receptionist going range for taking ammo bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game crashing after placing BrassBox to the storage shelf bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some localization issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapon cleaning station bugs.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements & Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Increased Workers speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Receptionist isn’t going to reception every time he picks up an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced sound for picking up ammo shells with machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Small optimizations for medium quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial for better understanding.[/p][/*][/list][p]You can join our discord for giving feedback or reporting bugs to help us make this game better.[/p][p]->[url="https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z"]https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z[/url][/p][h3]  [/h3]

notes.title: New Weapon Cleaning Mechanic!
notes.content: [p]With this new update your guns will be worn out as customers use them. Clean them regularly if you want to use them longer! [/p][p][/p][p]Buy and place a cleaning station in your shop, fill it with sprays, and make your customers thrilled with clean guns! There are different mini-games inside to make cleaning bearable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115774/f5447b933f5a386207cb4669ba18bf53bab815dc.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As you progress, you can unlock a machine that cleans your guns for you! This way you would have more time left for opening cases![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115774/64fd343984e62b16e814e85ff1bebd26c511ec86.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Shooting Range Simulator Launches Early Access on September 3rd!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Get ready to take control of your very own shooting range – [b]Shooting Range Simulator[/b] officially launches on [b]September 3rd[/b]! 🗓️[/p][p]Manage every aspect of your range: keep your shelves stocked, rent out a variety of firearms, and sell ammo packs to eager customers. Expand and upgrade your shop to attract more visitors, level up your popularity, and unlock access to even better equipment.[/p][p]Test your luck by opening cases, then sell the skins you find for profit. Prove your skills in thrilling shooting tournaments, climb the rankings, and show that you’re the best in the business.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967850/Shooting_Range_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Follow and Wishlist it now![/p][p][/p][p][b]At launch, you can expect:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🏪 Full shooting range management gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]🔫 Gun rentals, ammo sales, and supply management[/p][/*][*][p]💼 Shop expansion and upgrades for better gear[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 Competitive shooting tournaments[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 Case openings and skin trading[/p][/*][/list][p]Mark your calendars – [b]September 3rd[/b] is the day to build, manage, and run your dream shooting range![/p]

notes.title: Shooting Range Simulator Demo Coming October 14th!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Shooting Range Simulator Enthusiasts...[/h1]

The demo of Shooting Range Simulator, which has been in development for a long time, will be with you soon. We are happy to announce that the Shooting Range Simulator Demo will be released on October 14th

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967850/Shooting_Range_Simulator/

[h1]About The Demo[/h1]
[h3]Check The Customer[/h3]
[list]
[*]Check the Customer's ID. It has to be appropriate for shooting! You are not managing a Toy Shop!
[/list]
[h3]Weapons & Ammos[/h3]
[list]
[*]Buy many weapons and rent them to gain money!
[*]Buy Ammos that appropriate for the Weapons
[/list]
[h3]Popularity[/h3]
[list]
[*]Buy new Weapons and Ammos with increasing Popularity!
[*]Satisfy the customers to increase the Popularity!
[/list]
[h3]Payments[/h3]
[list]
[*]If you accept the customer who is not meeting the requirements, you have to pay a penalty!
[/list]
[h3]Upgrade Your Shop[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can upgrade your range!
[*]After upgrading, there will be more to do list in the range like placing a Shooting Paper!
[*]Get more rent payments with upgrading range!
[/list]
[h3]Decorate Your Shop[/h3]
[list]
[*]Decorate your shop with seating areas, tables and more.
[/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fxwy8x2zTx2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115774/12ca4283cb76439f5d046214323133af4b23746f.png[/img][/url]

[h3]You can join our discord to talk about the Shooting Range Simulator! We can't wait to hear your ideas about the game![/h3]
